responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the root module file and its nested module files. compiler/rustc_resolve/src/rustdoc.rs: Provides rustdoc-oriented helpers for extracting, normalizing, and analyzing documentation text during resolution. It models doc fragments from attributes and comments, removes indentation for markdown parsing, parses candidate intra-doc links, and maps markdown ranges back to source spans so late resolution can resolve doc links and report precise diagnostics.
